note: One record per feature/rule ID in the current GDD snapshot. Statuses are copied from the GDD, never promoted. Only the design owner (Richard, GDD 1.3 section 14) and the technical lead (Josh) change status or implementation_authorized, and every status change is a manifest PR with the gdd_impact.py list. GDD 1.3 marks the P0 baseline APPROVED_P0 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026), so those records are implementation_authorized; APPROVED_P0 still means build only after the official jam start (Interpretation contract). Checked by tools/manifest_check.py. The tests mapping (feature -> QA ids) is the pipeline's reading, kept in step with pipeline/qa/test-map.md; the GDD gives it only for UMB-03 (Appendix B) (D-new-qa-mapping). default_enabled is also the shipped flag default: tools/bake_preset.py writes it from the approved workbench preset (D-new-workbench-debug), and only for implementation_authorized records when it differs. Numbers: approved_parameters (GDD 1.3 section 5A).

rejected_without_id.name: automatic fast fall from umbrella state (closed/lowered = faster fall; any per-state gravity multiplier)
rejected_without_id.gdd_ref: GDD 1.3 section 3 critical invariant; section 5A ('No per-state gravity multiplier exists'). A separate optional fast-fall modifier is MOVE-02, EXPERIMENT and off.

camera_mode.gdd_ref: GDD 1.3 section 1 World (fixed-camera single-screen arena); section 7 Encounter space (fixed 16:9 gameplay camera); Appendix A Arena (fixed camera REQUIRED). Scrolling is CAM-02, EXPERIMENT, off.
known_limitations: GDD 1.3 answers Q11: fixed 16:9 single screen is P0. 'scrolling' stays an allowed value only for the CAM-02 experiment (off). Background layers slide (BG-01) but never move the camera or hitboxes.

team_baseline.source: 11/8 team meeting (Drive Meeting Notes, 11/8); decision row D-new-team-baseline
team_baseline.standing: Pipeline default only. Not a GDD approval: no status, priority or implementation_authorized changes until Richard (GDD approver) confirms, with the design reviewer from the 11/8 notes reviewing.
agreed: Attack-descent mode fires automatic straight-ahead shots that stop when the umbrella opens (COM-01, DEC-02).
A separate shield-descent mode absorbs shots and heals the umbrella. GDD B1.0 has no feature ID for it yet (DEC-03).
Controller in scope for PC; mobile and swipe out (DEC-01).
Ascent causes no wear; certain wind currents damage the umbrella (WIND-02, DEC-07).
The umbrella's visual condition is the health (DEC-04); healing only via shield mode.
Screens: title/start, defeat, survived (the owl leaves).
Pipeline frozen before the Nov 12 kickoff. Feature-complete Nov 13, Nov 14 test and polish (planning target).

defaulted_2026_11_09.completion: A timer as a test-only placeholder; DEC-06 stays open.

team_baseline.superseded_by_gdd_1_3: GDD 1.3 (Richard-approved, commit 73b6a93) answers the 11/8 baseline and the 2026-11-09 midnight defaults. Where they differ the GDD wins: default is UP_OPEN, hold ATTACK (left mouse / R2) or SHIELD (right mouse / L2) to descend, shield wins; P0 is approved; completion is 90 s ACTIVE time; shield heals 20 HP with a 2 s cooldown; wind wear and owl gust off. 'Space hold for umbrella' and 'timer as a test-only placeholder' no longer apply. Source: GDD v1.3.

Section 3 step 5: steering is read independently of umbrella configuration, in every state.

features.name: gravity_fall
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).
One gravity rule whenever upright-open lift is unavailable; attack and shield descent fall naturally. No per-state gravity multiplier (section 5A). Extra fast fall is MOVE-02 (off).
Fall speed is fixed in the shipped build; sliders exist in debug builds only (D-new-workbench-debug).

features.name: upright_open_lift
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).
UP_OPEN is the default when ATTACK and SHIELD are released; only UP_OPEN lifts (section 3 steps 6-7).

features.name: limited_health_and_bottom_defeat
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).
One HP resource (100 HP, 34 per bolt, 0.8 s invulnerability). Three hits is a consequence of the numbers, not a hit counter (section 6). Answers DEC-04 (source: GDD v1.3).

features.name: survive_until_owl_departs
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).
Completion: 90 s of accumulated unpaused ACTIVE time; the rule stays replaceable (section 8). Answers DEC-06 (source: GDD v1.3). The owl cannot be killed.
Defeat and completion in the same update: defeat wins; exactly one terminal event (section 7B).

features.name: automatic_attack
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).
Hold ATTACK -> ATTACK_DESCENT -> fixed +X shots, first one on entry, then every 0.65 active s; shield or release stops new shots at once (section 7B). Answers DEC-02 (source: GDD v1.3).
Shots spawn from a stable named muzzle socket; animation frames never change cadence or direction (section 7A).

features.name: fixed_forward_attack_descent
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).

Only the fixed-forward (+X) configuration is approved. Variable aim angles and charged aim stay optional and unauthorized (Appendix D: 'player aim angle' not authorized). The old aim_arc parameter is removed.

features.name: sideways_projectile_catch
known_limitations: Appendix B lists projectile_contact in requires; that is the ProjectileContact event of the Projectile Service, recorded here as projectile_service. Appendix B acceptance_tests: QA-04, QA-10.
Toggle at reset. OPEN_LEFT / OPEN_RIGHT never give lift (section 3 steps 7, 9). Front shield is DEF-01.

features.name: umbrella_inversion
known_limitations: Needs a contained ticket, scenario and acceptance measure before any code (Interpretation contract). Toggle at reset.

features.name: visible_umbrella_wear
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).

Umbrella wear shows the one HP value in four stages (intact 67-100, damaged 34-66, critical 1-33, defeated 0). Damage never reduces lift in baseline; that is SURV-04 (off). Answers DEC-04 and DEC-05 (source: GDD v1.3).
Renamed from condition_affects_lift: in GDD 1.3 the lift effect has its own ID (SURV-04).

features.name: shield_absorption_heal
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).

A successful front catch heals 20 HP if the 2 s cooldown is ready; inside the cooldown the bolt is still blocked but heals 0. Never above max (section 6). Health/Condition owns the heal. Answers DEC-03 (source: GDD v1.3).
Was catch_restores_condition, requiring UMB-03; GDD 1.3 ties it to the front shield (DEF-01).

features.name: wind_force
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).
One safe environmental upward current, +180 cm/s while inside, no wear; off only in the T-02 movement test. Distinct from owl gusts (OWL-02). Answers DEC-07 (source: GDD v1.3).

features.name: wind_wear

Section 7B: 2.0 s grace, telegraph every 3.0 active s, aim snapshot at windup (no homing), 0.75 s warning, 350 cm/s straight bolt, seed 20261112. collision_radius is per-asset data, ENGINEERING_PROVISIONAL.

features.name: front_shield_descent
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).

features.name: clock_body_hit_regions
known_limitations: APPROVED_P0 in GDD 1.3 (Richard, 8 Nov 2026). Build only after the official jam start (Nov 11 21:00 PST, D39). Answers D-new-p0-signoff (source: GDD v1.3).

CLOCK and BODY colliders with stable region IDs; CLOCK wins on overlap; one BossTargetHit per projectile. Clock-hit visual cue on, no clock effect. Owl has no HP and cannot die (section 7). Answers DEC-08 (source: GDD v1.3).
Collision sizes live in a gameplay collision config, never derived from art; changing them needs Richard's approval (section 7C).

approved_parameters.source: GDD 1.3 section 5A, approved by Richard as provisional tuning (not balanced values). Units: Unreal cm and s. Sliders show unit and value, stay in range, use the step, apply on scenario reset unless live-safe. Omitted values: an explicit per-module safe value marked ENGINEERING_PROVISIONAL here. No AI tunes these.
